meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Conventional Commits 格式写提交信息:首行是 `type(scope): 摘要`,只在必要时才加正文,并把消息作为可直接粘贴的代码块输出。它只写消息,不执行 git commit、不暂存文件、不 amend。
howto.when: 当你要求写提交信息(如 "write a commit"、"commit message")或输入 /commit 等命令时触发接管;说 "stop caveman-commit" 或 "normal mode" 则回到啰嗦的提交风格。

say.text: 帮我写这次的 commit message
写一条 feat(api) 的提交信息,说明为什么要改
say.note: 首行带上 scope,正文写 non-obvious 的原因

say.text: 把这条提交信息压缩到只保留意图
say.note: 去掉套话,保留 type、摘要与必要正文

howto.what_en: Claude writes terse Conventional Commits messages compressed to intent: a `type(scope): summary` subject line, a body only when needed, output as a paste-ready code block. It only writes the message; it does not run git commit, stage files, or amend.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a commit or commit message, or use /commit or /caveman-commit. Saying "stop caveman-commit" or "normal mode" reverts to the verbose commit style.

say_en.text: Write the commit message for this change
say_en.note: Outputs a Conventional Commits message in a code block

say_en.text: Write a feat(api) commit message explaining the why
say_en.note: Adds the scope and a non-obvious why in the body

say_en.text: Compress this commit message to intent only
say_en.note: Drops fluff, keeps type, summary and needed body
